_why: Gate check 5b: the browser and library globals the code may use by bare name. ECMAScript built-ins (Math, JSON, Map, console, ...) come from a pristine V8 context and are not listed. Kept explicit on purpose: a typo that happens to be a window property (name, status, event, top, parent) must not pass silently. A new browser API is one line here, visible in review.
